violated_contract: An explicit native memory submission is raw input until the canonical required processor records normalization. A platform intake adapter must preserve that admission metadata instead of relying on the kernel's processed fallback, which otherwise allows raw input to look eligible for vector publication and unreceipted promotion.
canonical_prevention: Build every native single and batch submission with the unchanged required-processing payload and source-attribution rules inside the authoritative intake funnel. Derive pending state from that server-owned metadata, retain a stable source surface and acceptance timestamp in operation identity, and let only a validated processor receipt settle normalization.
